about: The versions Dependabot cannot see (it updates package.json and the actions in .github/workflows/; nothing else). scripts/versions.mjs reads each one where it is written and compares it with the newest release; the monthly workflow .github/workflows/versions.yml opens or updates an enhancement issue when one is behind. Each entry says where the version is written and how to move it; the version itself is never copied here.

versions.move: An even-numbered Node that is long-term support moves CI and scripts/cloud-setup.sh together, with @types/node and the full suites ("Node's version" in docs/developing.md).
A new pin takes the binary's SHA-256 for x64 and arm64 from nodejs.org's node-v<version>-linux-<arch>.tar.xz, checked against its SHASUMS256.txt, as the comment above the pin says.
